results.title: Super Troopers 3
results.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

results.title: Abot Langit
results.overview: The relationship of a couple is tested when the girl’s first official flight pairs her with a confident senior pilot, jealousy and power dynamics surface in the training ground. The girl is now torn between her present relationship and new temptation she can’t resist.

results.title: The Storm
results.overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

results.title: Cerita Lila
results.overview: Following a fatal history of severe maternal domestic abuse, the discarnate spirit of a young twin navigates the afterlife in a desperate search for her separated sister, uncovering a clandestine metaphysical conspiracy designed to obscure the truth of their deaths.

results.title: The History of Concrete
results.overview: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

results.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
results.overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

results.title: Master of the Universe
results.overview: A young man must use his untapped powers to fight back against an evil alien and their army, who will stop at nothing to take over Earth and then the universe.

results.title: Normal
results.overview: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

results.title: All That We Never Were
results.overview: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

results.title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
results.overview: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

results.title: Beast
results.overview: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in one championship against the brutal champion Xavier Grau.

results.title: Killer Whale
results.overview: Follows best friends Maddie and Trish as they find themselves trapped in a remote lagoon with the dangerous killer whale named Ceto.

results.title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
results.overview: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

results.title: Kesong Puti
results.overview: Have a taste of VMX Newest Temptation Apphle Celso. Lena, a Kesong Puti vendor, meets a charming dairy supplier Manny. Their chemistry sparks a daring secret that transforms her humble cheese into their town’s obsession.

results.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
results.overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

results.title: Vampire Carnival
results.overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

results.title: They Will Kill You
results.overview: A woman answers a help wanted ad to be a housekeeper in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that she is entering a community that has seen a number of disappearances over the years and may be under the grip of a Satanic cult.

results.title: Club Kid
results.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

results.title: Modha Rathri
results.overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

results.title: The Pout-Pout Fish
results.overview: Living on a rundown shipwreck, Mr. Fish one day discovers a hyperactive young sea dragon Pip – who had mistaken his home for a junkyard – pilfering his belongings. The heated argument that ensues leaves both their houses in ruin. But there is hope! Embarking on a seemingly impossible quest in search of the mythical 'Shimmer' to grant them a wish, there’s only one problem: someone else is on the hunt...
